summary: Phase 3 complete: created Cslib/Logics/Modal/Metalogic/Intuitionistic/IS4.lean instantiating the Phase 1 scaffold at IS4 = IT + fourBox/fourDia (the '4' axiom). IS4ModalAxiom extends ITModalAxiom's 16 constructors with fourBox (□A→□□A) and fourDia (◇◇A→◇A). is4_axiom_sound extends it_axiom_sound's 16 cases verbatim (htrans threaded unused) plus the two new '4' cases: fourDia composes two diamond witnesses directly via htrans (⟨t, htrans hru hut, hφt⟩); fourBox relocates the nested box goal via F2 (down-confluence, exactly the IK.lean idb pattern) to a world w2 where htrans composes r w2 w''' with r w''' v. is4_canonical_reflexive is the verbatim it_canonical_reflexive proof (tBox/tDia + axiom_mem + canonical_imp_property). is4_canonical_transitive is new and fully positive: box clause via axiom_mem(fourBox)+MP => □□φ∈w, then two box-clause applications (hwu.1, huv.1) => φ∈v; dia clause via two dia-clause applications (huv.2, hwu.2) => ◇◇φ∈w, then axiom_mem(fourDia)+MP => ◇φ∈w. is4FC bundles reflexivity+transitivity as a local predicate (∀ w, r w w) ∧ (∀ {w x y}, r w x → r x y → r w y), following IT.lean's itFC convention (not Mathlib's deprecated Reflexive/Transitive). is4_completeness/is4_consistent/is4_soundness_completeness instantiate ivalidFC_completeness with is4_canonical_fc := ⟨is4_canonical_reflexive, is4_canonical_transitive⟩ as h_canonFC. Zero sorry, zero new axioms beyond propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound, zero build warnings. Task-480/492/Phase-1-Extension/Phase-2-IT.lean files untouched (git diff confirms only Cslib.lean +1 import line, plan checklist edits, and the new IS4.lean file).

deviations.what: Frame condition named is4FC (local def, (∀ w, r w w) ∧ (∀ {w x y}, r w x → r x y → r w y)) instead of Mathlib's Reflexive ∧ Transitive
deviations.why: Reflexive/Transitive are deprecated in the pinned Mathlib version; using them would emit build warnings at every use site, violating the zero-warnings gate. is4FC mirrors IT.lean's own itFC local-predicate convention (already established in Phase 2) -- same semantic content, no design change, and consistent with the codebase convention this dispatch was explicitly instructed to follow.
